title: DTKG: Dual-Track Knowledge Graph-Verified Reasoning Framework for Multi-Hop QA
authors: Changhao Wang; Yanfang Liu; Xinxin Fan; Anzhi Zhou; Lao Tian; Yunfeng Lu
why_relevant: Proposes a KG-based multi-hop QA framework with a denoiser to filter noisy retrieved paths, tangentially touching noisy retrieval in RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Primary focus is multi-hop reasoning strategy classification rather than robustness under unreliable evidence; denoising is a minor component.
